name: plotarmordev/drama-tensorfold
title: Drama 3 voice model now runs out of the box on a 16 GB NVIDIA card, about 2.6x faster than real time on an RTX 5060 Ti
summary: A fix to the drama-tensorfold repo lets the 14.5 GB build of Drama 3 run on 16 GB NVIDIA GPUs. A third-party user measured about 2.6x faster than real time on an RTX 5060 Ti costing under 500 euros, with the fix and numbers in a public pull request.

appearances.title: Pruned NVFP4 Drama 3 quant fits under 17 GB
appearances.summary: An unofficial community quant keeps 5,900 of Fish Audio Drama 3's 10,240 experts in NVFP4. It is 18 GB on disk, peaks under 17 GB of GPU memory, and the author could not measure a quality drop against the previous version.

appearances.title: Drama 3 uses one speech API on DGX Spark and Mac
appearances.summary: A Drama Tensorfold update serves Fish Audio Drama 3 on a DGX Spark and a Mac through the same OpenAI-style /v1/audio/speech endpoint. One command starts it on the Mac, and cloned voices made on the Spark work there too.

appearances.title: Drama 3 local voice server exits with the caller
appearances.summary: Drama 3, a voice model that runs on your own computer, now shuts down its voice server when the tool that started it exits, freeing the RAM. It runs on DGX or Mac.

appearances.title: Drama 3 reads speaker tags for multi-voice scripts
appearances.summary: A Drama 3 recipe for DGX Spark and Mac now reads speaker tags, so one script can be voiced by several speakers. The 4-bit build finished every dialogue test; the full model can run long on short tagged lines.
